Subject: Repro + traces — crash with long system prompt during streaming

Stephanie / Marcus,

Having a high-priority POC issue with Acme Health (contact below). They hit a hard runtime crash when using our streaming endpoint with a very long system prompt (~13k tokens). The request is a standard chat completion where the initial system role contains a large policy blob. The model variant is redwood/open-7b-v2-q4f16 (hosted); session uses SDK streaming.

Attached: rt-trace-20260305.zip (stack + gcore), repro_input.jsonl (minimized).

Observed behavior:
- Streaming starts, we send first tokens, then after ~1200 tokens the server process dies (SIGSEGV).
- Trace shows NullRef in kv_cache prefetch path (runtime kernel prefetch code).
- Customer cannot continue POC without a workaround.

Ask:
1) Can platform confirm whether this is a runtime bug in the prefetch/prefix cache path?
2) Any immediate mitigations we can apply (runtime flags, env vars, SDK header) we can push to the customer?
3) ETA for a fix and whether we should pause streaming on this customer's instances.

Immediate action items I need from you so we can triage:

Subject: Re: Repro + traces — crash with long system prompt during streaming

I reproduced locally using the provided small_repro.sh against v2.1.2 and confirmed a crash in the prefetch path. Root cause (short): when prefix length expands past the prefetch chunk boundary we end up with a stale pointer during KV cache reallocation in streaming mode.

Temporary mitigations we validated:
- Start runtime with --kv-prefetch=0 (disables prefetch; streaming still works but with slightly higher token latency)
- Or have SDK set header X-Disable-Prefetch: 1 on request; runtime will honor header and skip the prefetch hot path.

Proposed fix:
- Patch to ensure safe KV reallocation and null-safety guard; PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/427 (includes regression test). Target: runtime 2.1.3 release.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ask customer to set X-Disable-Prefetch: 1 via SDK header as immediate workaround. I can provide a snippet the SDK team can add to docs and a hotfix branch for the hosted fleet to read that header.
2) We'll include the runtime 2.1.3 patch and backport if needed.

I attached prefetch-fix.diff with the core change and a test harness. Will follow up with a build for QA.

-marcus
